ITEM 1 | Bright green broccoli florets with yellowish-green tops, clustered in the center and right of the bowl, some with small cut stems, roughly 2-3 cm across each, firm and dry-looking with slightly granular surface | 120
ITEM 2 | Mixed raw leafy greens including flat green spinach-like leaves and frilly lettuce-type leaves with ruffled edges, mostly bright to dark green with some reddish-purple tinged leaves, spread across the bowl, crisp and dry-looking | 70
ITEM 3 | Small dark reddish-purple beans or berry-like pieces, glossy, roughly 1-1.5 cm, scattered among the greens, firm and whole, mostly in the upper-left and lower-center | 25
ITEM 4 | Thin reddish-pink stem or vein of a leaf lying across the lower-center of the greens, about 5 cm long, smooth and slightly glossy | 2
